tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background behind every view. Rows and sections sit directly on it, divided by `line` hairlines.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Areas that read as one object: the Up next card, dialogs, sheets, inputs, and the top and tab bars (92–94% over `bg`).

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Quiet fills: chips at rest, skeletons, hover rows, Work group headers, empty progress tracks.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and titles on `bg`, `surface`, `surface-2` and `teal-soft` (14.8:1 / 15.5:1 on `bg`, light / dark).

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Body copy and secondary titles on `bg` and `surface` (9.9:1 / 12.0:1).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Meta lines, dates, counts and helper text on `bg`, `surface` and `surface-2` (5.0:1 at worst, on `surface-2` light).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: 1px hairlines between rows and sections, card rings, track outlines. Decorative: never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: Borders of interactive controls (checkboxes, step markers, rating segments, inputs) and empty status rings. 3.2:1 on `bg` light, 4.1:1 dark (meets the 3:1 non-text floor).

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: Progress and done: filled checkboxes, done status, progress bars, the primary button fill, the active tab underline. Text on it uses `on-teal` (6.2:1 / 7.1:1).

tokens.name: teal-strong
tokens.usage: Teal as text: links, the "Done when" label, active tab text, on `bg`, `surface` and `teal-soft` (6.6:1 at worst). Primary button hover.

tokens.name: teal-soft
tokens.usage: Tint for the lecture goal panel, the catch-up banner and the finished-lecture panel. Text on it uses `ink` or `teal-strong`.

tokens.name: on-teal
tokens.usage: Text and check marks on `teal` fills (white in light, deep teal in dark).

tokens.name: now
tokens.usage: Now / next marks only: the Up next left rule, the now-line, the current step ring, today's tick and cell. Non-text marks, 3.5:1 on `bg` light. Never text, warnings, saving or focus.

tokens.name: now-ink
tokens.usage: Orange as text: the Up next eyebrow, "Today", "This week", the now-line time, on `surface` and `bg` (5.7:1 / 9.0:1).

tokens.name: now-soft
tokens.usage: The 4px halo behind the current step marker. Decorative.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Warning text: "Ask instructor", save errors, on `warn-soft` and `bg` (5.9:1 / 8.1:1). Never for past work that isn't ticked.

tokens.name: warn-mark
tokens.usage: Warning marks: the Ask instructor status icon, the Weak strength dash (3.6:1 on `surface` light).

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind warning text.

tokens.name: code-bg
tokens.usage: Code block background. Dark in both themes.

tokens.name: code-ink
tokens.usage: Code text on `code-bg` (13.2:1 / 14.9:1).

tokens.name: code-meta
tokens.usage: The code block's label ("Terminal", "Claude prompt") on `code-bg` (7.0:1 / 7.4:1).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The 2px keyboard focus ring at a 2px offset, solid, on every surface (7.6:1 on `bg` light, 10.9:1 dark). Teal, never orange.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Floating layers: menus, the palette, sheets and the phone lecture pill. In dark it is lighter than `surface`, because depth on near-black comes from lightness, not shadow.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: The 1px edge of raised things, drawn with box-shadow (never border, so states never shift layout). Alpha, so it adapts on tints.

tokens.name: ring-strong
tokens.usage: Secondary buttons, hovered cards, the segmented thumb and key caps.

tokens.name: line-soft
tokens.usage: Dividers inside a card or dialog (palette input, sheet footer). Row dividers between list items keep `line`.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: The 1px inner top highlight on raised things in dark mode (off in light).

tokens.name: track
tokens.usage: The empty part of every bar, ring, step rail and segment strip: teal at low alpha, so value and track read as one hue.

tokens.name: row-hover
tokens.usage: The hover pill behind rows, tabs, step headers and quiet buttons. Animates by opacity only.

tokens.name: row-sel
tokens.usage: Selected or current rows (the row you came back to, the palette selection) and the rating hover fill, paired with a 2px teal bar.

families.display: "IBM Plex Sans Condensed", "Arial Narrow", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif
families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: View titles and today's date, one per view. Use `display-sm` on phones.

styles.name: lecture-title
styles.usage: The H1 of a lecture page (30px/34px on phones).

styles.name: title
styles.usage: The step title inside the Up next card (21px/27px on phones).

styles.name: section
styles.usage: Section headings. Sentence case, never uppercase eyebrows.

styles.name: step-title
styles.sample: Back up, then drop the tables
styles.usage: Step titles in a lecture guide.

styles.name: panel-title
styles.usage: Side-panel headings, week names on Course, sheet titles.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: How logins work, then Claude Code gives your app real email accounts.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Commit first so you can roll back.
styles.usage: Default text: step detail and descriptions. Max 68ch.

styles.name: row-title
styles.usage: The title line of a list row.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Row sub-lines, dates, counts and helper text, in `muted`.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Rating end labels, tab bar labels, badges. The smallest text allowed.

styles.name: mono-label
styles.usage: Lecture codes, times, step numbers and counts. Always tabular figures.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tight gaps: icon to label in chips and badges; gaps between timeline blocks.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between buttons in a group; between a heading and its list.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between a row's icon, text and end; between cards in a grid.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: The phone page gutter; card padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Dialog side padding; phone page top padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Up next card padding on desktop; toolbar to list.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page header to first block; desktop page top padding.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Between major sections in the main column.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Main column to side panel; above the lecture pager.

tokens.name: r-xs
tokens.usage: Key caps, badges, the now-line time pill.

tokens.name: r-item
tokens.usage: Items inside a track: the segmented thumb, palette tiles.

tokens.name: r-ctl
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, rating segments, menu items, row hover pills.

tokens.name: r-code
tokens.usage: Code blocks.

tokens.name: r-panel
tokens.usage: Up next, recall cards, banners, pager links, menus, the toast.

tokens.name: r-dialog
tokens.usage: The palette, dialogs and the top corners of phone sheets.

tokens.name: r-pill
tokens.usage: Badges, bars, segment strips and the phone lecture pill.

radius.note: Nesting rule: inner radius = outer radius − inset, rounded down to the nearest token (a 12px menu with 4px padding gets 8px items).

tokens.name: row
tokens.usage: Minimum list-row height on desktop (52px on phones, set in the stylesheet).

tokens.name: bar-h
tokens.usage: Top bar height on desktop and the bottom tab bar on phones (the top bar is 48px on phones).

tokens.name: tap
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target on phones. Smaller visuals extend their hit area with a pseudo-element.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max page width.

tokens.name: main-max
tokens.usage: Max width of the main column next to a side panel.

tokens.name: rail-w
tokens.usage: Side panel width on desktop (280px under 1100px).

shadow.note: Depth means something. Rows sit flat on hairlines; things you act on sit one level up (raise); floating layers sit two or three levels up (float, pop). Never animate box-shadow: a hover shadow lives on a pseudo-element and fades in. In dark, depth comes from the ring, a top highlight and surface-raised.

tokens.name: shadow-ring
tokens.usage: Quiet framed things: code blocks, empty-state tiles.

tokens.name: shadow-raise
tokens.usage: Things you act on at rest: Up next, the recall deck, pager links.

tokens.name: shadow-raise-hover
tokens.usage: The same things on hover, on a ::after that fades in.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Menus, the toast and the phone lecture pill.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: The palette, dialogs and sheets.
